focus.normalMethod: Unit vector from v16-B renderPositions[model] minus surfacePoints[model]; same nearest-face normal used in original validated +0.8 mesh offset; no mesh reanalysis
focus.targetMethod: (renderPositions[displayModel] - GLB bbox center)/GLB maxExtent; preserve sourcePosition and renderPositions
focus.orientation: Yaw from surface normal X/Z, pitch clamped +0.45..+1.42 radians; +Y world up; yaw angular unwrap
focus.distanceMethod: 5.5 measured diameters of visible context converted via GLB maxExtent and FOV=0.88 radians; visible vertical size constrained 0.16..0.26 normalized; distance range 0.17..0.31 then conservative height guard
focus.reducedMotion: immediate move if media preference is reduce
focus.collisionValidation: offline 46/46 target eye positions are above global GLB maximum Y by at least 0.012 normalized, strict sufficient no-mesh-intersection at endpoints; interaction safety bound recomputed for orbit/zoom/pan
focus.clippingAssessment: Conservative camera Y guard and near=clamp(distance*0.012,0.0015,0.008); GPU clipping not tested in current environment

mobile.caveat: DOM and pointer-state flow checked using mocked WebGL2; actual GPU touch-picking requires hardware validation
